verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of multi-project or organization isolation patterns, such as resource hierarchy, folders, sandbox projects, or org-policy guardrails, that would keep experiments away from prod. The related material does not deliver the story itself: IAM permission control, budgets, and Infrastructure Manager preview deployments (a dry-run, not sandbox isolation) are only adjacent controls. The axis clearly applies to a cloud platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, experiments cannot hurt prod — documented multi-account/project isolation patterns (org units, sandboxes) with guardrails
